2:3.text: Do nothing from selfishness or conceit, but in humility count others better than yourselves.
2:3.notes: Fetched 2026-10-15 in both RSVCE (bible-history.com) and RSV; they agree. Ch. 11 Further Study had wrongly said "more significant" (not RSV wording); fixed in Redline 24.

2:4.text: Let each of you look not only to his own interests, but also to the interests of others.
